text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Agnes Tachyon is that girl
who was in that scandal the other day.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that girl? I was curious, so I watched
her race footage from the Kikuka Sho, and she was pretty good.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you managed to get results at the Kikuka Sho, but...
I wonder how it'll go this time.
"Oblivious to the buzzing crowd, Agnes Tachyon let out a leisurely yawn."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Tsk, tsk, how naive, Guinea Pig-kun.
Relaxation is the very essence of focus."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Right now, by using breathing techniques and progressive muscle relaxation,
I am unwinding both mind and body.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "This is a bona fide mental training technique based on sports science."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Besides, today is the long-awaited first race
of your target schedule, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I intend to take responsibility
for getting your hopes up that day."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As a little bonus along the way
to reaching beyond the limit—
I shall present you with a few victories.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's hear all about your plans for the Senior year.
A few days after the Kikuka-sho, that is what she promised me.
With those words, she flashed a cynical smile.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit. Just sit back, relax,
and watch the race with full confidence!
